Ketan Agarwal Murder Case: Defense lawyer questions evidence, prosecution claims

In the Ketan Agarwal murder case, the defense lawyer for accused Siya Goyal has questioned the evidence presented by the prosecution and stated they will oppose any requests to extend custody. The prosecution is reportedly relying on circumstantial and digital evidence, including CCTV footage and call details, as there are no eyewitnesses. The case has also seen claims from the accused's brother regarding the lawyer and the disappearance of the victim's passport.
